description: Catalog of real-world app forks used to smoke-test vite-plus pre-releases. Source of truth for tooling and the release-manager skill.

fields.name: fork repo name under the org
fields.branch: the branch to test (often NOT the fork default branch)
fields.packageManager: pnpm | npm | yarn | bun | node (no committed lockfile) | other (non-JS)
fields.notes: free-form (e.g. CI runs on push only, special setup)

repos.name: bippy
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork, so its check fails with `Check failed (404): The app https://github.com/apps/pkg-pr-new is not installed`. Unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: BlockNote
repos.notes: BlockNote. 15 `vp` scripts, mostly `vp run -r`. `build.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. `minimumReleaseAge: 1440` is already excluded for `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*`, so no supply-chain patch is needed.

repos.name: brazilian-utils-javascript
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the `Test on Deno` job fails on `expect(...).toHaveBeenCalledTimes is not a function`, a Deno test-environment issue independent of the vite-plus version.

repos.name: cloudflare-os
repos.notes: `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `minimumReleaseAge: 1440` and its exclude list omits vite-plus, so add `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*` to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` on the test branch. That gate keys off publish time, so it also rejects a real release on release day. Gate `preview.yml`, `bonk*.yml`, and `cla.yml`, which need credentials the fork lacks.

repos.name: codiff
repos.notes: CI triggers on push only; PRs do not run CI unless the workflow adds a pull_request trigger

repos.name: delta-comic
repos.notes: CI triggers on push only; PRs do not run CI unless the workflow adds a pull_request trigger

repos.name: dify
repos.notes: Dify. Largest catalogued vite-plus consumer. `vp check`, `vp lint`, `vp config`, and `vp run` drive the TS side; `api/` is Python and does not. `main-ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` and its `trustPolicyExclude` does not list vite-plus, so add `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*` there on the test branch or the preview build is rejected. Its `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` already covers the toolchain. 36 workflows, so read the failing job rather than the first red check.

repos.name: dotabod-backend
repos.notes: fork-CI noise is limited to jobs the fork cannot run: the `build (*)` Docker image jobs need registry credentials (`Password required`) and `format` needs a token (`Input required and not supplied: token`). The `test` job is the real signal and does pass; if it fails with `Cannot find native binding`, that is the bridge flake, so re-run it.

repos.name: elysia-clerk
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork; its check fails with a 404. Unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: evcc
repos.notes: evcc. Go backend with a Vue frontend; only the frontend uses vite-plus (`vp dev`, `vp fmt`, `vp lint`). No committed packageManager field. `default.yml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. No supply-chain gate in `.npmrc`.

repos.name: fate
repos.notes: project-side: `example/server-graphql/scripts/generate-graphql.tsx` imports `oxfmt` without declaring it, so it only resolves through hoisting. Fails with `Cannot find package 'oxfmt'` whenever the lockfile is regenerated. Unrelated to vite-plus.

repos.name: jaeger-ui
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the `check-label` job requires every PR to carry a `changelog:***` label, so ecosystem-ci test PRs always fail it. The `lint-build` job also runs project meta-checks (`knip`, `check-overrides`) that fail whenever dependencies change. Unrelated to vite-plus.

repos.name: koel
repos.notes: pinned to a very old vite-plus (0.1.x) and still using the removed `@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-test` alias, so `vp migrate` performs a multi-release jump. Resulting TypeScript errors are not evidence about the release under test. Re-pin before using it as an upgrade signal.

repos.name: matterviz
repos.notes: blocked: `@janosh/vite-config` resolves to a package with no `main`/`module`/`exports`, so loading `vite.config.ts` fails with `Failed to resolve entry for package "@janosh/vite-config"`. No vite-plus version can run here until the dependency is fixed.

repos.name: mcp-omnisearch
repos.notes: preview-build limitation: the Docker build context does not carry the bridge `.npmrc`, so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` inside the image rejects the commit-build tarball URLs with `ERR_PNPM_TARBALL_URL_MISMATCH`. Cannot happen for a real npm release.

repos.name: media-processors
repos.notes: project-side: a package imports `esbuild` without declaring it and only resolves it through hoisting, so it fails with `Cannot find package 'esbuild'` whenever the lockfile is regenerated. Unrelated to vite-plus.

repos.name: museeks
repos.notes: project-side: `@stylexjs/unplugin` wants `unplugin ^2` while the repo installs 3.x. A regenerated lockfile makes this fatal under `strictPeerDependencies: true`; set it to false on the test branch.

repos.name: npmx.dev
repos.notes: The org copy is a detached fork (no GitHub parent), so `gh repo fork` cannot re-link it; the `source` remote must be added by hand.

repos.name: ohbug
repos.notes: project-side: `@ohbug/unplugin`'s webpack entry pulls webpack/tapable and postcss CommonJS `.d.ts` files that rolldown-plugin-dts cannot bundle, so its `postinstall` build fails. Set `pack.dts: false` for that package on the test branch. Reproduces on older vite-plus releases.

repos.name: orval
repos.notes: Orval. Deepest `vp run` usage in the catalog (19 scripts) and one of the few bun projects. `pr-checks.yaml` runs on `pull_request` without secrets. `bunfig.toml` sets `minimumReleaseAge = 259200`, so bun rejects any fresh publish; set it to `0` on the test branch, because bun's `minimumReleaseAgeExcludes` does not accept the `@voidzero-dev/*` glob.

repos.name: oxc-playground
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: publish/release steps need `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`, which the fork does not have, so they fail with `Failed to replace env in config: ${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`. Unrelated to vite-plus. NOTE: the org fork is actually named `playground` (GitHub redirects `oxc-playground`), so `gh` calls that build a URL from this name land on the redirect.

repos.name: oxc-walker
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` sets `trustPolicy: no-downgrade`, which rejects bridge preview builds because they carry no provenance. Add `trustPolicyExclude` for `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*` on the test branch.

repos.name: pdfme
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `.npmrc` sets `min-release-age=3`, so npm rejects a fresh publish with `ETARGET`. Set `min-release-age=0` on the test branch.

repos.name: rari
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` rejects bridge preview builds, and also `cytoscape` as a pnpm cross-major false positive (pnpm/pnpm#10202). Add both to `trustPolicyExclude` on the test branch.

repos.name: react-doctor
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` rejects bridge preview builds, and also `semver@6.3.1` as a pnpm cross-major false positive (pnpm/pnpm#10202). Add both to `trustPolicyExclude` on the test branch. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: react-hookz-web
repos.notes: The only yarn project in the catalog (yarn 4.x), so it is the sole cover for yarn install and migrate paths. The org fork is named `react-hookz-web`, because `web` is ambiguous. `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request` and its only secret is `CODECOV_TOKEN`; that upload failure counts as passing. No supply-chain gate.

repos.name: redis-me
repos.notes: no pull_request-triggered workflow of its own (only `release.yml` on tags), so a test PR reports "no checks". Add `.github/workflows/ecosystem-ci-build.yml` running `vp check` and `vp build` on the test branch each release; see "Forks with no PR CI". Also needs `@types/node` and `"node"` in the tsconfig `types` array, because `vite.config.ts` uses `path`, `process`, and `import.meta.dirname` and `vp check` fails without them. Drop the added workflow once the repo runs these checks on pull requests itself.

repos.name: svelte-multiselect
repos.notes: blocked: same `@janosh/vite-config` problem as matterviz. The package has no entry point, so `vite.config.ts` cannot load and no checks run.

repos.name: trpc-nuxt
repos.notes: On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: unplugin-turbo-console
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork; its check fails with a 404. Unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: urllib
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the CodSpeedHQ/action step fails on the fork (installer hash pin mismatch and `401 Unauthorized` on upload) because the fork has no CodSpeed token. Its CI also installs behind Socket Firewall (`sfw vp install`), which cannot reach `registry-bridge.viteplus.dev` and fails with `ERR_PNPM_META_FETCH_FAIL`; the bridge itself is healthy, and a real npm release resolves from registry.npmjs.org. Both are unrelated to vite-plus.

repos.name: varlet
repos.notes: On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: videojs-v10
repos.notes: Video.js v10. Scripts run the toolchain end to end: `vp config`, `vp run -r build`, `vp check`, `vp lint`, `vp fmt`, `vp test`. `pkg-pr-new.yml` needs the pkg-pr-new App, which this org does not install, so gate that job on the fork.

repos.name: vinext
repos.notes: `ci.yml` runs on `pull_request`, needs no secrets, and covers `vp run build`, `vp run check`, `vp run knip`, and sharded `vp test run` unit and integration suites. High-signal fork. Gate the `preview-release`, `release`, and `*-cloudflare-deploy` workflows, which need credentials the fork does not have.

repos.name: vitepress-carbon
repos.notes: pins `packageManager: pnpm@9.9.0`, which stalls forever at 0% CPU installing through the registry bridge. Bump the pin to the latest v9 on the test branch. Reproduces on older vite-plus releases, so it is not release-specific.

repos.name: vitepress-plugin-group-icons
repos.notes: supply-chain gate: `trustPolicy: no-downgrade` rejects bridge preview builds. Add `trustPolicyExclude` for `vite-plus` and `@voidzero-dev/*` on the test branch. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".

repos.name: vue-clamp
repos.notes: fork-CI noise: the pkg-pr-new GitHub App is not installed on the fork (404), and the test job flakes on `ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications`. Both unrelated to vite-plus. On the test branch, skip the preview-publish step: it needs a GitHub App or token the fork does not have and does not exercise the pinned Vite+. See "Forks that publish a preview package".
